descriptions.w3d_move_queue_construct: Initializes an AI move queue object: sets its type table, clears its move list and counters, then resets it.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_destroy: Tears down an AI move queue, frees its move list storage and optionally deletes the object itself.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_release: Drops one reference from a move queue and destroys it through its type table when no references remain.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_reset_800039ac: Clears the queued moves and resets the progress counter of a move queue.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_current_step: Returns the data of the last queued move, or a shared default entry when the queue is empty.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_pop_front: Removes and frees the first queued move; when the queue becomes empty it marks it finished and posts a message.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_advance: Advances the queue depending on its state, then starts the next move through its type table if any remain.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_check_timeout: In the timed-wait state, calls the queue's timeout handler once the configured wait time has elapsed.
descriptions.w3d_move_queue_start_wait: Records the current engine time and a wait length, and puts the move queue into its timed-wait state.
descriptions.w3d_move_step_apply: Appears to apply a move step's coordinates and flags to an object using a shared cursor, returning the object.
descriptions.w3d_move_type_name: Returns the debug name of an AI move type (walk retry modes, jumps, jetpack, parachute, ninja rope, super sheep, delay).
